minimum_reference_rationale: Local structural eligibility only: at least two real cells per split-half for variance. Actual DE and anchor eligibility is decided by unmodified cell-eval2, not this count rule.
gene_policy: Use all 18533 official gene labels in exact CSV order. Map each source to this axis with an explicit measurement mask. Local scoring uses the context-measured official subset; never zero-fill missing measurements. Full-axis output remains the 2026 submission target.
target_policy: Official 300 targets are the deployment panel; all valid source targets may supply auxiliary supervision. Report official overlap separately; backgrounds with no overlap remain auxiliary transfer benchmarks.
mapping_policy: Exact official slots first, HGNC unique bridges with source Ensembl conflict checks; exclude duplicate mapped features. Preserve distinct official historical labels even when HGNC merges their aliases.
correctness_policy: Full finite/nonnegative/integer count scan; remove zero native or zero measured-official libraries, unresolved targets and cells lacking both input/scoring NTC batch support. No response-strength, knockdown, mitochondrial or guide-agreement filtering in this contract.
ntc_policy: Deduplicate physical study/context/batch/barcode identities and verify H1 count-vector equality before splitting; balanced deterministic half split within batch, input cap applied with proportional batch quotas; no physical overlap.
reference_policy: At most 400 unique real cells per target, deterministic identity ranking. Keep all smaller groups that pass structural eligibility; never replicate real cells. S0 holds out half before the 400 cap. Full local metric populations and undefined metrics must be retained.
scorer_policy: Official ArcInstitute/cell-eval2 at 5e64833518a6603a0301cbe28185d49c30f4a986, vcc2026 preset, official baseline/real_bundle/score APIs. Scientific parameters and six-member aggregation are not tuning knobs.
independence_policy: Five contexts, three source studies; guide/GEM/seed are not biological repeats. Unresolved replicate identity remains unknown.
runtime_completion: Before claiming any normalized local score, materialize the registered reference, official baseline and 5-split anchors, record their hashes and all metric gates. Failure or degenerate anchors blocks Overall; data-contract completion alone is not experiment completion.
